title: Expression Audit State
description: State file for the self-expression-audit skill. Tracks progress across modules, stores raw Q&A, tension log, prototype anchors, and compiled outputs. This is the system's spine — all continuity between sessions flows through this file.

version.description: Schema version. Increment when state structure changes. Current: 1.0

subject.description: Name or identifier of the person being interviewed

mode.description: The mode selected for this session

completedModes.description: All modes the subject has completed. Used to determine upgrade eligibility.

progress.description: Per-module progress tracking. Each key is a module ID.

prototypeAnchors.description: Three-tier prototype hypothesis tracking. Each anchor records the hypothesis, evidence, and confirmation status.

anchor1.description: After D0 completes. Initial hypothesis formed from identity signals.

anchor2.description: After D2 completes. Hypothesis refined using expression mechanism data. Replaces original D3/D4 anchor.

anchor3.description: After all modules complete. Final confirmation or pivot.

tensionLog.description: Cross-module contradictions and tensions. Each entry records a conflict between answers from different modules. This is the core material for prototype evaluation and the final report.

coreIdentity.description: Synthesized core identity statement. Null until enough data is collected. Updated at each prototype anchor.

confidence.description: How confident the system is in this statement based on data collected

basedOnQuestions.description: Question IDs that contributed to this identity statement

quickReference.description: Quick Reference Card — the subject's expression rules in 3 categories. Null until sufficient data.

always.description: Things the subject always does in their expression

never.description: Things the subject never does in their expression

signatureMoves.description: Distinctive expression techniques or approaches the subject uses

resonanceLog.description: Tracks the subject's resonance level with each person/idea mentioned during D0. Levels: admiration → recognition → identification → direction. See modules/resonance-detector.md

resonancePoints.description: Nodes in the influence graph that produced strong identification-level resonance. These are potential north star candidates.

candidateNorthStar.description: The current best hypothesis for the subject's north star, derived from the discovery loop.

level.description: Current resonance level of this candidate

evidence.description: Question IDs and resonance log IDs that support this candidate

stressTestResult.description: Results of the 5-item stress test (noAudience, noMoney, noFame, noTemplate, tenYears)

northStarLoop.description: Tracks progress through the 8-round North Star Discovery Loop. See modules/north-star-discovery-loop.md

currentRound.description: Current round (1-9). Null if loop not started.

candidates.description: De-personalized candidate directions generated during the loop

resumeFrom.description: Human-readable description of where to resume

northStarHistory.description: Version history of the subject's north star. Each entry records a confirmed or revised north star.

knowledgeGraph.description: The influence graph built during knowledge archaeology. A graph (not tree) of people, books, theories, eras, and traditions that influenced the subject's north star candidates. See modules/knowledge-archeology.md

nodes.description: Nodes in the influence graph (people, books, theories, eras, traditions)

resonanceNodes.description: Node IDs that produced strong resonance (identification or direction level)

learningPath.description: Recommended learning path derived from the knowledge graph.

directReading.description: Books/articles directly cited by the subject's north star figures

prerequisiteReading.description: Background knowledge needed to understand second-order influences

comparativeReading.description: Pairs of thinkers who answer the same question differently

nextExploration.description: Suggested next directions for exploring the influence chain

rawData.description: The sole source of truth for all answers. Keyed by question ID (Q1-Q108). Each entry stores the question, answer, depth level, and any follow-ups.

metadata.description: Operational metadata. Not part of the analysis output.

sessionCount.description: Number of sessions/interactions with this subject

lastModuleRun.description: ID of the last module that was run

notes.description: Any operational notes for the interviewer

status.description: not_started: no questions answered. partial: some answered. complete: all required questions answered.

totalQuestions.description: Total number of questions in this module

answeredQuestions.description: Question IDs that have been answered (e.g. ['Q1', 'Q13', 'Q18'])

availableQuestions.description: All question IDs in this module (e.g. ['Q1'-'Q18'])

status.description: pending: not yet evaluated. hypothesis_formed: initial hypothesis recorded. confirmed: hypothesis validated by subsequent data. pivoted: hypothesis changed based on new data.

hypothesis.description: The prototype hypothesis at this anchor point

evidence.description: Question IDs and brief notes of evidence supporting the hypothesis

contradictions.description: Tension log IDs that challenge or nuance this hypothesis

id.description: Unique tension ID, auto-incremented (T1, T2, T3...)

sourceQuestions.description: Question IDs that create this tension (e.g. ['Q1', 'Q49'])

resolution.description: How this tension was resolved or interpreted (if resolved)

resolved.description: Whether this tension has been addressed in the final output

depth.description: The depth level at which this question was answered. quick = no follow-up. core = with follow-ups. deep = fully explored.

followUps.description: Follow-up questions asked and the subject's responses, interleaved

upgraded.description: Whether this answer was deepened during a mode upgrade (quick→core or core→deep)

module.description: Which module this question belongs to (e.g. 'D0')

density.description: How many structural dimensions this answer reveals (1-5). Populated during compilation.

tags.description: Structural dimensions illuminated by this answer (e.g. ['identity', 'belief', 'aspiration'])

round.description: Which round of the discovery loop this was detected in

person.description: The person or idea this resonance is about

upgraded.description: Whether this resonance level was upgraded from a lower level

triggerQuestion.description: Which question triggered this resonance detection

triggerPhrase.description: The exact phrase that triggered detection

level.description: Must be identification or direction to be a resonance point

order.description: Order in the influence chain (1=first-order, 2=second-order, etc.)

reason.description: Why this was marked as a resonance point

statement.description: The north star statement at this version

context.description: Context in which this was confirmed (e.g. '首次审计，核心模式')

evidence.description: Question IDs and round IDs that contributed

changeNote.description: If this is a revision, what changed from the previous version

name.description: Name of the node (person, book, theory, era, tradition)

materialType.description: Material type: form (一阶), method (二阶), source (三阶)

source.description: Which question or round revealed this node

keyWorks.description: Key works associated with this node

keyIdeas.description: Core ideas associated with this node

influencedBy.description: Names of nodes that influence this one

type.description: influenced_by: A influenced B. co_cited: A and B both cited C. member_of: A belongs to tradition B
